HomePage.description: A secure and transparent digital platform established by the Ministry of Mines to receive, track, and resolve public complaints and feedback related to mining activities. Empowering citizens, improving service delivery, and strengthening governance through accountability.

ComplaintPage.title: Submit a Complaint
ComplaintPage.subtitle: Please fill out the form below to submit your complaint. Provide accurate and complete information to help us process your complaint efficiently.

personalInfo.title: Personal Information
personalInfo.shareHint: Share your contact details so we can update you about your complaint.
personalInfo.anonymousTip: Prefer not to share your details? Choose “Continue anonymously”. Keep your tracking number safe — it is the only way to follow up on an anonymous complaint.
personalInfo.anonymousNotice: Your complaint will be submitted anonymously. Keep your tracking number safe — it is the only way to follow up on your complaint.

tips.title: Complaint Tips
items: Be clear and concise in your description.
Attach any supporting documents if necessary.
Provide your contact information for follow-up.
Incomplete or unclear complaints may take longer to process.
